name: btn-hover-multiple
title: Multi Shadow Hover Button
description: A blue Contact me pill that sits alone until hovered. Then it shifts up and left while three progressively paler copies fan out below and to its right, like a stack of cards.
use: A contact or primary action button needs extra presence and a tactile hover without adding imagery.
avoid: The blue palette is fixed in the class names, and the offset stack needs free space to the right and below.
a11y: Real button text and a native focus ring help, but the stacked-shadow reveal only fires on hover, never on keyboard focus. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pill-shaped button filled with a navy-to-blue gradient and outlined in brighter blue, with white Contact me text. At rest one pill stands alone; hovered, three paler blue copies step out to its lower right.
behaves: On hover the button slides up and left over a third of a second while three rounded shadow layers in deepening blues fan out to the lower right underneath. Moving off collapses the stack and returns the pill to centre.
customise: The label, gradient, border and shadow shades are hardcoded class names; it accepts no props and needs a file edit to change.
weight: light: One button and three CSS box shadows, with no JavaScript.
